Name: IFT_Missed_Count
Expression:
VAR CurrVehicle = MAX(ERR[Caller Base Location])
VAR PrevBoundary =
    MAXX(
        FILTER(
            'ERR',
            'ERR'[Caller Base Location] = CurrVehicle &&
            'ERR'[IFT_Index] < MAX(ERR[IFT_Index]) &&
            'ERR'[IFT_Boundary] = 1
        ),
        'ERR'[IFT_Index]
    )
VAR NextBoundary =
    MINX(
        FILTER(
            'ERR',
            ERR[Caller Base Location] = CurrVehicle &&
            'ERR'[IFT_Index] > MAX(ERR[IFT_Index]) &&
            'ERR'[IFT_Boundary] = 1
        ),
        'ERR'[IFT_Index]
    )
RETURN
COUNTROWS(
    FILTER(
        'ERR',
        'ERR'[Caller Base Location] = CurrVehicle &&
        'ERR'[IFT_Index] > PrevBoundary &&
        'ERR'[IFT_Index] < NextBoundary &&
        'ERR'[Ambulance Assigned] = 0
    )
)

Name: ART Shortfall Measure
Expression:
VAR AvgMin = AVERAGE(ERR[ART mins.])
VAR Target =
    SWITCH(
        SELECTEDVALUE(ERR[Locality (BL)]),
        "Urban", 18+5,
        "Rural", 23+5,
        "Tribal", 33+5
    )

VAR Diff = Target - AvgMin

RETURN
IF(
    Diff = Target,
    BLANK(),
    SWITCH(
        TRUE(),
        Diff > 0, "<0 min",
        AND(ABS(Diff) < 5, ABS(Diff) > 0) , "0-5 min",
        AND(ABS(Diff) < 10, ABS(Diff) > 5) , "5-10 min",
        AND(ABS(Diff) < 15, ABS(Diff) > 10) , "10-15 min",
        AND(ABS(Diff) < 20, ABS(Diff) > 15) , "15-20 min",
        ">20 min"
    )
)

Name: O-O Difference Case wise
Expression:
VAR CurVehicle =
    SELECTEDVALUE(ERR[Vehicle Id])

VAR CurCallTime =
    SELECTEDVALUE(ERR[Calltime])

VAR CurODO =
    SELECTEDVALUE(ERR[1. On Action ODO])

VAR NextODO =
    MAXX(
        TOPN(
            1,
            FILTER(
                ALL(ERR),
                ERR[Vehicle Id] = CurVehicle &&
                ERR[Calltime] > CurCallTime &&
                NOT ISBLANK(ERR[1. On Action ODO])
            ),
            ERR[Calltime], ASC
        ),
        ERR[1. On Action ODO]
    )

VAR Diff = NextODO - CurODO

RETURN
IF(
    ISBLANK(CurODO) ||
    ISBLANK(NextODO) ||
    Diff < 0 ||
    Diff > 1000,
    BLANK(),
    Diff
)

VAR avg_sec =

            ERR,
            DATEDIFF(

Name: Segment Served Flag

VAR MinDate = MIN(Calender[Date])

        COUNTROWS(ERR),
        REMOVEFILTERS(Calender),
        REMOVEFILTERS('Vehicles Master Database'[Special Base Locations Flag]),

        ERR[Date] < MaxDate + 1,

            ERR[Date] <= MaxDate,
            ERR[Ambulance Base Location] = SelectedBase

    RETURN

                    ERR,
                    NOT ISBLANK(ERR[Assign Time])
                        && NOT ISBLANK(ERR[Accepted Time])
                        && DATEDIFF(
                            ERR[Assign Time],
                            ERR[Accepted Time],
                            SECOND
                        ) > ThresholdSeconds
                )
            ),
        "On Action Time",
            CALCULATE(
                DISTINCTCOUNT(ERR[Event Id]),
                ERR[Ambulance Assigned] = 1,
                FILTER(
                    ERR,
                    NOT ISBLANK(ERR[Accepted Time])
                        && NOT ISBLANK(ERR[On Action Time])
                        && DATEDIFF(
                            ERR[Accepted Time],
                            ERR[On Action Time],
                            SECOND
                        ) > ThresholdSeconds
                )
            )
    )

Name: EMT Deviation Filter
Expression:
VAR SelectedDeviation =
    DIVIDE(
        SELECTEDVALUE(
            'Deviation % Slicer'[Deviation %],
            20
        ),
        100
    )

VAR CurrentDeviation =
    [Deviation % Dynamic]

VAR HasCasesSelection =
    ISFILTERED(
        'Deviated Cases Slicer'[Deviated Cases Range]
    )

VAR SelectedCases =
    SELECTEDVALUE(
        'Deviated Cases Slicer'[Deviated Cases Threshold]
    )

VAR CurrentDeviatedCases =
    [Deviated Cases Dynamic]

RETURN
    IF(
        CurrentDeviation > SelectedDeviation
            && (
                NOT HasCasesSelection
                    || CurrentDeviatedCases > SelectedCases
            ),
        1,
        0
    )
